page_title: PAR 2-2 MAR | Paris FC v Marseille 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Jeremie Pignard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90+5' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Bilal Nadir (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is going to take the penalty!
90+3' 2 - 2 Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the top left corner, ricocheting in off the post. Geronimo Rulli was helpless.
90+1' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. It's a penalty! Paris FC have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
90+1' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adama Camara as he is replaced by Willem Geubbels (Paris FC).
85' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
83' Neat passing move from Paris FC in order to create new attacking opportunities.
82' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) does well to meet a cross inside the box and powers a header past the helpless goalkeeper.
81' Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
80' The game has come to an end for Timothy Weah. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Michael Murillo (Marseille).
79' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Quinten Timber and he is replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) comes onto the pitch for Igor Paixao.
77' Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) jumps into a tackle and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul.
76' A quickly taken corner by Paris FC.

76' Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the top left corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Geronimo Rulli. Paris FC have been awarded a corner kick.

74' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
73' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner which is cleared.
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Facundo Medina (Marseille) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' One of the players from Paris FC times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
70' Igor Paixao (Marseille) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
70' 5:15 – the total goal attempt statistics.
67' Substitution. Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ethan Nwaneri walks off.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang leaves the pitch and Amine Gouiri (Marseille) comes on.
64' The substitution is prepared. Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alimani Gory.
64' Here is a change. Jean-Philippe Krasso is going off and Stephane Gilli gives the last tactical orders to Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC).
64' Here comes a substitution. Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) is brought on as a substitute for Moses Simon.
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Marseille, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
61' Adama Camara (Paris FC) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement.
60' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Moses Simon (Paris FC) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
56' Nice passing game by Paris FC. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
53' 0 - 2 Goal! Mason Greenwood feeds Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:2.
52' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
46' Stephane Gilli makes a half-time substitution. Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) comes on in place of Maxime Lopez.
46' The whistle blows and Jeremie Pignard starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off the line to clear the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
43' The referee shows a yellow card to Maxime Lopez (Paris FC). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
42' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is flagged for offside.
39' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
39' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
38' Great chance! Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot well wide of the left post.
38' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
37' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) picks up an injury.
35' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle as Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
34' A pass from Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli and the move breaks down.
33' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
29' Quinten Timber (Marseille) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
27' The corner from Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli.
27' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) connects with a loose ball in the box, but sends his first-time shot miles over the bar.
22' A great solo run by Timothy Weah (Marseille) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Kevin Trapp.
22' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kevin Trapp to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
18' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
18' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Marseille!
17' There's a break in play and referee Jeremie Pignard must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Marseille using VAR. This could be interesting!
17' That looked a certain handball by Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
16' A pass from Alimani Gory (Paris FC) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli and the move breaks down.
16' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
15' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) is about to take a corner kick.

15' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is in the right place at the right time to meet a rebound and attempts a header towards the left side of the goal. Kevin Trapp is alert and denies him with a quick save. Marseille have a corner.
14' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) will take the corner.
12' Timothy Weah (Marseille) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' The ball is cleared after Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC).
8' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Good work from Paris FC as they win a corner.
8' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
7' Igor Paixao (Marseille) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
3' The ball is played back to Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
2' Igor Paixao (Marseille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Marseille will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
